steps.say: Ask for a Standard recap of The Cartographer's Silence (cs-1) at 4:03:17 from the Catch me up button. Until the host lands the JWT library, the service refuses every bearer token by design (research R-2) and this step records 401; once it does, the step records 404 until LB3's import has written a BookImported for this listener on book-cs-1, and 200 { bookId, tier, position, recap: { state: awaited }, answeredOffer: false } after that.
Ask again without having moved: the same {tier} at 4:03:17 answers exactly as the first did and records nothing new — the request stands until CU5 drafts it (R4).
